content: OV2640 via esp32-camera: QQVGA 160x120 JPEG frames typically 4-12KB at jpeg_quality 10-20 (lower number = higher quality = larger). Quality 0-5 risks corrupt JPEGs from DMA overflow on detailed scenes (esp32-camera issue 150); recommended range 10-20. Actual size varies per frame - read fb->len, never assume fixed size.
